## What you did
- Root cause of Orbitly's ~8% iOS funnel drop: our own kestrel-ios 3.2.0 made `event_id` a per-session counter, so #240's dedupe collapsed distinct events across devices. You rekeyed dedupe on (project, device, event_id), all 412 tests green, and opened PR #247 with Maya reviewing [1][2].

## What changed
- Maya will approve #247 once CI is green, and wants the drop count for Thursday's call with Orbitly: you have it — ~1.18M legitimate events (≈8.1% of their iOS volume), 4,352 being genuine replays; Zest lost 3,812 [2][1].
- Rachel: Zest confirmed their dashboards are complete again after the backfill; their Zendesk ticket is closed [6].

## What is still open
- Once #247 is deployed, replay Orbitly from landing from 13/11 (~40 min, skips genuine replays), then the same for Zest, and verify `ingest_dedupe_dropped_total{project="prj_0rb1"}` stays near zero [1].
- Add an alert for when the ingest dead-letter queue goes above 1,000 messages — due before Friday's incident review (20/11) [7].
- The drafted note to the iOS team still needs sending: restore UUID `event_id`s in 3.2.1, otherwise this bites again [1].
